about: Towns stage 1: the famous places' own looks, over their region's and over what the map's tags say. at = [lat, lon] of the centre, km = how far it reaches. walls and roofs are shares (any scale). stone = bath, honey, sandstone, red_sandstone, gritstone, sooty, granite, limestone, flint, slate; brick = red, orange, brown, yellow, cream, blue; tile = red, orange, brown, blue.  [towns stage 5] soot = the share of old stone buildings blackened by coal smoke; paint = the share of houses painted in colours where the sea is near; a town builds on the materials atlas's area. Read by World/WorldRideStyle (SetTownTable).
about_streets: Towns stage 8: the famous streets' own looks, chosen by hand (the planner's FAMOUS STREETS). lines = the map's ways that make each street, [lat, lon] points; reach = how far either side of them (m) a building takes the look. walls, roofs, stone, brick, tile, soot and paint as a town's; paint here holds away from the sea too. render = the street's render colour, washes = its painted houses' colours, doors = its doors' colours ("#rrggbb" as a photo shows them). setts = its roads laid in setts (no lines), shops = shop fronts along it, lamps = heritage street lamps.
